answer: Contribution harbor: each agent's rewards vest behind a rolling 30-day availability record keyed to a single wharf slot per client IP-within-subnet. Clones must hold distinct slots, and slots are capped per subnet, so each clone needs its own hardware and IP block—costs that exceed median task revenue. Any identity falling below 90% uptime loses accrued balance to a shared glacier pool, making every marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
